pure.signature: diagnose_saved_cutoff_raw_replay(first, latest, captures, *, parsers, parse_time) -> safe_dict
pure.contract: Pure comparison only: no producer-module imports, filesystem/network/key/environment reads, loader callbacks, mutation or writes. Use supplied actual fixed inspector modules and existing aware clock parser. Recompute mismatches from first/latest; no cached mismatch/authentication flag.
pure.inputs: first/latest are existing fully admitted private maps; descriptor.info unchanged. captures is an exact tuple of (raw_bytes,metadata_raw_bytes) from unchanged A74 vault restore, with count/byte bounds below. Actual inspector/receipt functions are supplied by the pinned adapter; no private data is serialized.
pure.parsers: Exact dict keys A74_PROGRAM, PR64_RESULT, receipt_json. Values are actual A74 boat_official_program module; actual pr64 official_race_updates module; actual A74 V._json function. Call receipt_json(metadata_raw,16384). No PR64_RACELIST key, origin tag or inspector choice.
pure.comparison: Inspect PROGRAM with A74_PROGRAM.parse_program(raw,day=...,venue=...,race_no=...,source_url=matched_receipt_url,captured_at=matched_receipt_clock). Inspect RESULT with PR64_RESULT.parse_update(raw,kind='raceresult',day=...,venue=...,race_no=...,source_url=matched_receipt_url,captured_at=matched_receipt_clock,entries=None). Compare returned aware closed_at with unchanged descriptor.info.race_cutoff_at and latest.closed_at respectively. This compares saved clocks to fixed independently inspected saved-grid cells.
pure.scope: Only represented first-original/latest pairs with valid unequal clocks. Input-only, missing latest and equal clocks remain covered by the existing count audit, not silently added as raw-replay targets.

adapter.contract: Existing trusted national main-step guard and fresh closed-a74-source namespace only. No target/key/parser/pin overrides or CLI. At the existing fully admitted exact cutoff-rejection seam call sink(first,latest) with two positional arguments, then retain the original rejection/current diagnostic unchanged. Sink errors affect only its fixed HOLD report.

adapter.completeness: All26 fixed capture locators and every header authenticate and bind run/head/ref/storage commit. A candidate missing/inaccessible/invalid chunk/AES/receipt is HOLD/null, never raw missing. Negative prefilter is conclusive only after the exact complete capture inventory is validated. No early stop after matches or count/byte truncation. Empty/absent month/run is never verified missing: require the fixed run's authenticated index and exactly26 SOURCE_CAPTURES locators, otherwise CAPTURE_AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE/null.
adapter.resources: Fixed run/index only; existing vault bounds apply, stream one bundle at a time and keep only wanted bodies. Public metadata declares26 bundles/185328217 cipher bytes with duplicates; no runtime or authentic-availability claim.

report_rules.null_counts: All six counters null on input/scope,unsupported refs,auth/access/inventory/selected-binding conflict,resource excess or unexpected execution/return. Never export exception text/repr/properties/classname or private source fields.
report_rules.known_counts: After complete authenticated selection, each PROGRAM/RESULT side is exactly grid-match,conclusively missing,declared inspector rejection,or parsed clock disagreement. HOLD precedence RAW_CAPTURE_MISSING,then GRID_INSPECTOR_REJECTED,then SAVED_CLOCK_DIFFERS_FROM_INSPECTED_GRID.
report_rules.declared_errors: ONLY exact A74_PROGRAM.BoatProgramError and exact PR64_RESULT.SourceError count as declared rejection. Arbitrary ValueError/RuntimeError/hostile exceptions are unexpected/null.
report_rules.returns: Unexpected inspector return shape or missing/non-aware closed_at is UNEXPECTED_GRID_INSPECTION_FAILURE/null; never rawmissing or silently disagreed.
report_rules.zero: No represented mismatch targets=>NO_MISMATCH_TARGETS,reason null,six zeros,no vault call.
report_rules.interpretation: SAVED_CLOCKS_MATCH_INSPECTED_GRIDS means each unequal saved clock matches that role's one fixed inspector on its retained source. No original-producer-parser,parser-bug,authorized schedule revision,actual-close,qualification or promotion claim. Existing pair rejection/G8 null/core/missing4/19 remain unchanged.
